BETA Close X Barratt Redrow PLC has announced the purchase of 2,345,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program. These transactions occurred between August 3rd and August 7th, 2026, with prices ranging from 298.40 pence to 326.20 pence per share, and a volume-weighted average price of 303.57 pence. Following these purchases, Barratt Redrow holds no ordinary shares in treasury, and the total number of issued ordinary shares is now 1,401,289,443, with the same number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 10 August 2026 10 August 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 3 August 2026 to 7 August 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 03 Aug 2026 468,000 306.0000 298.4000 303.5736 LSE 04 Aug 2026 269,531 308.0000 301.0000 304.9015 LSE 05 Aug 2026 468,000 316.4000 312.4000 314.5651 LSE 06 Aug 2026 468,000 321.6000 316.1000 318.6791 LSE 07 Aug 2026 398,000 326.2000 316.3000 320.7932 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 9,230,810 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,401,289,443 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,401,289,443.
